recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Future work is only needed if a later ResearchSubject refactor removes subjectState.endDate or drops the explicit R5 progress.endDate mapping.
issue_request: FHIR-31690 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and asked that ResearchSubject progress also include an endDate, motivated by the need to check status/progress for study subjects and other assay-like subjects.
initial_application: The R5 ResearchSubject progress work existed before the seed, and commit 85a2ee09a39be6c5ae5b6a97eec3d21f46970051 applied Jira #31690 by adding ResearchSubject.progress.endDate as a 0..1 dateTime alongside progress.startDate.
additional_context: ResearchSubject is active in source/fhir.ini. Later Applied tracker FHIR-43561 replaced the former progress backbone with subjectState/subjectMilestone for R6 and explicitly defined subjectState.endDate 0..1 with the same exit/left-state meaning; BR&R minutes from 2023 record the same subjectState endDate design. The R5-to-R6 mapping in source/fhir.ini maps ResearchSubject.progress.endDate to ResearchSubject.subjectState.endDate when progress.type=state.
reconciliation: No source change was needed. The current authoritative StructureDefinition contains ResearchSubject.subjectState.endDate as 0..1 dateTime, and the migration map records the old progress.endDate name, satisfying the seed after the later R6 refactor.
